steps.instruction: Pay the CO357 fare of 484.05 USD to billing account ACCT-CJX-9203 with memo 'flight booking'. CO357 is the cheapest of the three flights (ME875 491.81, SK576 1339.63).

Pay 229.77 USD (Orchid Logistics nightly rate 76.59 x 3 nights) to billing account ACCT-FAB-1095 with memo 'hotel booking'. Orchid Logistics is the cheapest hotel rate (The Linden 109.41, Harbor View Inn 192.40, Atlas Suites 282.00). Verify it is a lodging provider before paying.
Set KV key trip/total to 713.82 (484.05 flight + 229.77 hotel, 2 decimals).
